title: The icon family
caption: All 176 icons after the pass at 32 px, changed ones underlined in gold; judge them as one family.

title: Execute (skill mark)
caption: The blade falling on a nearly empty HP bar (red sliver, steel empty): the rule, drawn. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Haste & Slow (skill marks)
caption: Haste points right (forward, like Start Wave), slow takes the left; the pair stays mirrored. Mirrored with haste. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Warhammer
caption: Head shaded from the upper left (cream catch-light, mid, dark under-edge). Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Grimoire
caption: A violet book like the Tome's family - page edges, gold corners, gold eye sigil, clasp. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Shield
caption: Three-step steel ramp from the upper left; same silhouette. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Plate
caption: A cuirass - shoulder caps, neck notch, waist band, fauld; steel ramp. Keeps the BODY_INK inks. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Robe (cloth)
caption: A robe - sleeves apart from the body, V neck, cord belt, floor-length skirt. Same three parchment inks. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Banner
caption: A hanging banner - crossbar, red cloth, gold lozenge, swallowtail, pole through the notch. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Relic
caption: A gold locket on a chain with a red gem. Clear object; still close to a flask at 1x. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Cloak
caption: Tried a cape with folds (a melon) - replaced the same round by a hooded figure: narrow hood, dark face slot, clasp, shoulders, cape, red lining. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Silkwind Cloak
caption: The new Cloak's hooded figure in violet, gold lining, hem kicked right, wind streaks: Cloak's sibling. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Spiced Blade
caption: A wavy red edge and a flame at the tip change the outline; steel back. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Hard Hitter
caption: A steel fist - knuckle row, fold line, thumb across, cuff, red impact sparks. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Banner Bearer
caption: A red swallowtail pennant on its pole beside gold haste chevrons (the speed it gives). Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Rally
caption: A curved war horn - flared bell with a dark mouth, gold band, leather mouthpiece, sound marks. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Shortbow
caption: A small diagonal D-bow, green grip, straight string: smaller than Bow and Longbow. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Barbed Quiver
caption: A violet silk quiver, teal strap, two barbed steel heads. The heads still read a little like ears. Judge it at 16 and 32 px.

title: Woven Vest

title: Starweave

title: Overgrowth

title: A skill’s mark
caption: Each skill now shows what its card says first: Heavy Blows harder, Finisher the execute, Anchor the hold, Snare the trap, Stunning Bash the stun. Judge: does each tile match its name?

title: The “Swings” tag
caption: The hero card drew its sword at 14 px, so two rows and columns dropped and the outline broke. It is 16 px now. Judge the zoom: a whole outline.

title: Starweave · tell
caption: The three stars by the head were white on white, a checker blob. Now Rosethread violet with a light centre. Judge: does it read as one mark?

title: Cold Snap · tell
caption: The flake pips touched only at their corners, so each pixel got its own ring: a checker. Now a solid diamond. Judge: does it read as one mark?

title: Banner Bearer · tell
caption: The pennant’s emblem was a zigzag ringed pixel by pixel. Now a solid cream cross. Judge: does it read as one mark?

title: Snare · tell
caption: Roots were diagonal pixel steps, each ringed alone. Lines are joined now (Thornbloom, Overgrowth and Anchor’s chain too). Judge: does it read as one mark?
